metadata.v0_message:
Invalid XML characters should be dropped, not encoded

Fixes #1743

jsoup.requirement: XML serialization must discard XML-invalid control characters while HTML retains escaped control characters. Preserve both HTML and XML assertions.

metadata.v0_message:
[CODEC-333] Add separate methods for strict Standard and URL Safe Base64 decoding (#419)

* Add separate methods for strict Standard and URL Safe Base64 decoding

* fixed javadocs + resolved other comments

codec_standard.requirement: Write a Standard-alphabet round-trip test for encodedText. Use the newly added decodeBase64Standard(String) API, preserve exact supplied text after standard re-encoding, and assert equality. Fixed provider values include empty input and + and / alphabet cases.

metadata.v0_message:
[CODEC-333] Add separate methods for strict Standard and URL Safe Base64 decoding (#419)

* Add separate methods for strict Standard and URL Safe Base64 decoding

* fixed javadocs + resolved other comments

codec_url.requirement: Write a URL-safe-alphabet round-trip test for encodedText. Use the newly added decodeBase64Url(String) API, preserve exact supplied text after URL-safe unpadded re-encoding, and assert equality. Fixed provider values include empty input and - and _ alphabet cases.

metadata.v0_message:
MethodUtils cannot find or invoke vararg methods when widening primitive
types following the JLS 5.1.2. Widening Primitive Conversion.

lang.requirement: MethodUtils.invokeMethod now supports primitive widening for varargs. Integer, byte, short and char arguments can select foo(long...). Preserve the existing unrelated checks and replace the obsolete two-integer NoSuchMethodException expectation with meaningful widening assertions.

metadata.v0_message: Add flags for min and max outliers as suggested in #79.

jfreechart.fault_origin: historical parent equals body with developer API retained
jfreechart.requirement: BoxAndWhiskerRenderer adds get/setMinOutlierVisible and get/setMaxOutlierVisible, default true. Equality must distinguish both fields. Extend the existing equality test, preserving earlier checks and checking equality after matching changes to each flag.
